'''Quekka Trench Station''' was an mostly automated [[Type 07034]] deep-sea plant used by [[Rendeel Industries]] to process [[Quekka fish]].<ref name="H&S" />

==History==
Quekka Trench Station was located in a twelve [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]] deep trench. While very profitable, a battle between local factions took place near it and the wreckage polluted the area and killed the schools of fish. Rendeel cleaned up the area, but let the plant go idle until the fish repopulated enough to make it worthwhile to operate again.<ref name="H&S" />
